proposals.relationship: As Jorge M.Escobar explains, O’Brien uses Latour’s purification and translation concepts to analyze settlers’ claims to exclusive modernity and Indigenous disappearance.
proposals.evidence_note: Explicit named scholarly mediation in Escobar’s actual indexed chapter116and127/n6, corroborated by O’Brien’s own selected indexedxxi–xxii/3–4 passages. Escobar distinguishes purification/translation and applies the framework to New Granada; his extension is not attributed to O’Brien. Full O’Brien chapter/pages and Latour original unread. proposals.evidence_note: Own selected public indexedxvii/xxiand56explicitly name Trouillot when widening historical production beyond professional historians, treating local histories as an archive, and considering public meanings made through commemoration. proposals.relationship: O’Brien credits Calloway’s helpful reading of the entire Firsting and Lasting manuscript.
proposals.evidence_note: Own public indexed acknowledgment207explicitly identifies his manuscript reading. The same selected context credits Jim Merrell’s reading of nearly every chapter and repeated introduction advice, and a Jennifer whose surname is not visible in the selected extract. Those distinct contributions are not assigned to Calloway. Bounded manuscript assistance, not proof of doctrinal agreement, coauthorship or an independently verified complete-book reading.

proposals.relationship: Wolfe uses O’Brien’s evidence on New England treaty status and earlier blood-quantum practices in his history of Indigenous racialization and dispossession.
proposals.evidence_note: Own fresh selected2016body and actual endnotes: chapter5/n30uses Firsting203for disadvantages facing tribes dispossessed before US treaty relationships; chapter6/n92uses Firsting128for an earlier Connecticut blood-quantum example. These are two specific resources within one pair/kind, not evidence that O’Brien endorsed Wolfe’s entire comparative framework. O’Brien’s cited pages remain unread in full; Wolfe’s original legal/historical sources are not independently checked. Ebook PDF pagination is explicit and not passed off as print pages.
